data.review_body: AliExpress uses online suppliers that are less than 50% reliable or legitimate. Expect a problem with shipping for many or most orders and constant delays and excuses. A lot of persistence is necessary to cancel and get a refund. I think since most orders are small that most buyers just forget about it and give up without a refund, which I think the seller hopes will happen. I used to order regularly from AliExpress but now I have given up completely. The suppliers need to be vetted by AliExpress and certified reliable, otherwise it is mostly a scam.
data.review_headline: AliExpress uses online suppliers that usually don't deliver

data.review_body:
Was offered a promotional "buy 1 item for free + 1 item at a discount" so I proceeded to pick out my items and everything seemed fine. I ordered through Paypal. Receive confirmation on Aliexpress that order was processing and completed. Went back to order page and the items were still listed as not paid for yet and that I had to order both together (which I thought I had done - just following their instructions). No paypal confirmation or record of purchase, so obviously was not successful. 

Attempted 2 more times and ended up back at the same place with the order saying completed, but also saying not paid for. Contacted support. Was told this sometimes happens and that I should add the items to my cart again and checkout, implying it was somehow my fault, then offered me a coupon which sent me to a 404 - page not found. Next day I get 4 different emails from support. One email telling me the order was fine and went through, another saying the order was closed due to not paying on time, another one saying I'd be refunded. Absolutely ridiculous. I checked the order page again. It clearly shows each item paid for by Paypal while on the same page saying that the orders were cancelled for failure to pay. Still no record of any payment made in Paypal.  WTF. I sent a final complaint by email, with all the screenshots and information I collected as proof  and have not heard back. 

The gaslighting, the contradictions, no attempt to make things right... NOPE... I'll take my business elsewhere. Seeing these other reviews is even more proof to me that they cannot be trusted to so much as handle a simple email. I'll be deleting my account. I'm not sharing the order numbers here in  this review because it doesn't even matter anymore. You have no intention of resolving mine or anyone else's issues. 

By the way, when you have over 180,000 reviews with an overall score of 2.0, the problem isn't your customers, it's you. THAT can't be resolved with tone-deaf AI generated responses on every review made. 

Update: And there it is, the canned reply to my review. Too late... I deleted my account and have no interest in dealing with you. You were given multiple chances. I was lucky. In the end, you didn't get my money. I'm more angry now seeing what other people are going through. Forget about me. Take care of these people who have lost money, time and sanity seeking REAL resolutions. 

Update 2: They clearly didn't even read the review.  I deleted my account, and they continue to send me promotional messages and more of the same AI generated crap, even after unsubscribing from their emails and telling them to stop emailing me. What is wrong with these people? I've never seen anything like it. 

If you're still considering buying from them... in 2022, the Office of the United States Trade Representative added AliExpress to its list of Notorious Markets for Counterfeiting and Piracy.
data.review_headline: Horrible customer service and order handling

data.review_body: Placed an order (first time user) and paid for it via PayPal. PayPal acknowledged order, provided a transaction ID and Invoice ID and the money was debited. No order was recorded in my AliExpress account, I left it a few days assuming that the system would catch up but it didn't. First tried to use the almost unusable chat to find out what had gone on and subsequently very slow email. In all cases day after day they just sent a screenshot of the find account button even though I had access to my account. After a week of this I raised a PayPal case and I await to see if my money is returned. I recommend avoiding this site despite the enticing prices, I have concluded based on the lack of customer support that the operation is a borderline scam.
data.review_headline: They will take and keep your money  and leave you with nothing
